license_note: The repository carries its own license file stating a Modified MIT License with a 2026 Mistral AI attribution notice. The MIT grant is conditioned on the licensee's global consolidated monthly revenue not exceeding 20 million US dollars for the preceding month, with a commercial-license contact offered as the alternative. That revenue restriction is not part of the OSI-approved MIT text, so the release is source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: Official Mistral-Medium-3.5-128B model repository, consolidated and sharded Safetensors checkpoints, tokenizer, parameters, and derivatives

access_boundary: This record represents the mistralai/Mistral-Medium-3.5-128B release (Mistral Medium 3.5, April 2026; dense 128B, 256k context). The EAGLE speculative-decoding sibling repository, the Magistral and Devstral lines, the mistral-medium-3-5 API product and Le Chat deployments, and downstream quantizations and fine-tunes remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Mistral AI publishes ungated consolidated and Transformers-style Safetensors checkpoints with tokenizer, system prompt, and an in-repository license file
The model card documents vLLM, SGLang, Transformers, llama.cpp, and Ollama paths, and Mistral serves the release as a GA priced API model that also ships as an NVIDIA NIM
tradeoffs: The Modified MIT License bars exercise of rights above a 20M US dollar monthly-revenue threshold, so the release is source-available rather than open source
The 128B dense footprint needs multi-GPU tensor parallelism per the serving guide
